passive.name: Way of the Wanderer
passive.tooltip:
Resolve: Moving grants Flow, which is tracked on Yasuo's resource bar. Moving faster grants more Flow. At maximum Flow, damage from a champion or monster briefly grants @ShieldValue@ Shield.

Intent: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased by @CritChanceMultiplier*100@% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to @CurrentCritDamage@. Gain @YasuoCritToAD*.01@ Bonus Attack Damage for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.

spells.name: Steel Tempest
spells.tooltip:
Yasuo thrusts, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage. If he hits, he gains a stack for @GatheringStormDuration@ seconds. While he has 2 stacks, his next use of this Ability fires a whirlwind from range, dealing the same damage and Knocking Up for @KnockUpDurationTOOLTIPONLY@ second.

If used while dashing, this Ability strikes in a circle rather than a stab.
spells.tooltipExtended: <rules>This Ability acts like an Attack: it can critically strike for <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageCrit@ physical damage</physicalDamage>, it applies %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-hit</OnHit> effects and lifesteal to the first enemy struck, is interruptible by crowd control, and its cooldown and cast time are reduced with <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed>.</rules>

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.tooltip: Yasuo creates a drifting wall of wind that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.
spells.tooltipExtended: <rules>Tower shots and beams are not blocked.</rules>

spells.name: Sweeping Blade
spells.tooltip:
Yasuo dashes through a target, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. Each use of this Ability grants @BonusDamagePerStack@ bonus damage to subsequent uses for @StackDuration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times.

This Ability has a @PerTargetCooldown@ second per-target Cooldown.

spells.name: Last Breath
spells.tooltip:
Yasuo teleports to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing @Damage@ physical damage and holding all nearby Airborne enemies up for an additional @RKnockupDuration@ second. Yasuo also gains maximum Flow, but loses all Steel Tempest stacks.

Afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes ignore @RPercentArmorPen@% bonus Armor for @RBuffDuration@ seconds.
